name: ppp
description: Releases of ppp: Power Platform solutions offline from solution exports. Optional: bi-deneb, Deneb visuals for Power BI; bi-design, the corporate design of Boehringer Ingelheim.

plugins.name: ppp
plugins.description: ppp: builds Power Platform solutions (Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Power BI, Copilot Studio) offline from solution exports; the user carries out tenant steps guided by cards.

plugins.name: bi-deneb
plugins.description: bi-deneb: Deneb visuals for Power BI in the brand design - skill and agent bi-deneb build a custom visual (Vega-Lite or Vega) from a brief with the generator bideneb, render it locally, check fields, Deneb rules, brand colours and legibility, and embed it into a Power BI project.

plugins.name: bi-design
plugins.description: bi-design: Boehringer Ingelheim corporate design for agents - skill bi-designer for any visual output (colours, fonts, logo, icons, recipes per medium) and agent bi-ppt, which builds, updates, checks and converts PowerPoint decks in the BI master v2.1 with the generator bippt.
